title: The Weeping Foundation
text: The mortar of one House's finest building has begun to weep. Not water: something thicker, warm, that runs down the walls in the night and pools in the shape of handprints. The masons will not go near it.

options.label: Tear the building down to its footings, and find what weeps beneath.

outcomes.text: The walls come down and the weeping stops. Under the footings, in the wet mortar, you find a heart of red stone, still beating.

options.label: Have it sanctified, whatever it costs.

outcomes.text: The priests sing for three nights. The weeping stops, the stones dry, and the building stands taller than before.

options.label: Paint over it and carry on. It is only mortar.

outcomes.text: The paint holds, mostly. You stop letting the children play in that wing.
